summary.text: Purple Thought Perception Starlight is Purple Mountain True Monarch's wisdom path killer move. Purple starlight specks contact an enemy's methods and send him fragmented information.

claims.text: Purple Mountain True Monarch keeps purple thought perception starlight activated. Countless starlight specks emerge from the pores of his body, fly around Duke Long, gather, shoot at layers of defense, and are broken continuously, while information reaches his mind.

In Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan chooses to modify Purple Mountain True Monarch’s wisdom path killer moves because they are powerful, he has grandmaster wisdom path attainment, and he already holds a batch of wisdom path Immortal Gu left behind by Purple Mountain True Monarch. Purple thought perception starlight is named in that batch with purple blood river formation, purple thought light shield, ignited thought flying rock, single thought flower blossom, directional confusion fog, thought body defense, and single thought myriad flow elimination, methods Purple Mountain True Monarch used to face Duke Long when not in peak condition.

On cloud soil Fang Yuan places his focus on this move last among the set. It is the most complex, with a powerful effect: every hit lets the user learn profundities of the enemy’s killer move and gather information, and once enough is collected he can use wisdom path methods in the fight itself, then the distinct killer move brilliant will dissolution to unravel the enemy’s move. The activation has many steps. Fang Yuan succeeds only after three tries and takes injuries, which Man as Before covers. The wisdom path killer moves he is using are already modified to some extent.
Fang Yuan uses purple thought perception starlight to break Qin Bai He’s defense. He then breathes sword light dragon breath that leaves only her head. His dragon claw tears the head into pieces.

Old Ghost Bai Jun’s immortal method binds Fang Yun and Fang Leng. Fang Yuan sees through it and removes the shackles, able to get rid of that binding easily because he has a killer move like purple thought perception starlight.

Against Thunder Ghost True Monarch Jing Lan, Fang Yuan waves a clenched right hand and innumerable bright purple starlight specks fly down after ignited thought flying rock. Jing Lan’s lightning eyes show disdain at the rocks, then her pupils shrink at purple thought perception starlight; she judges it an extraordinary killer move she must evade. Turned into lightning, she charges through the ignited thought flying rocks but dodges and detours around the purple specks.
Fang Yuan judges that purple thought perception starlight can be condensed into multiple Immortal Gu, unlike moves that elevate into a single Gu worm.

Known users.text: Purple Mountain True Monarch Fang Yuan
